## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🕌 Tajweed Engine Rule or Unicode update (requires Scholar Review Panel sign-off)
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX styling alignment (Gilded Slate Theme)
- [ ] 🌐 Translation / Localization addition

## Checklists

### 💻 Developer Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have run the linter successfully (`npm run lint` passes without errors)
- [ ] I have run local build compilers (`npm run build` succeeds)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors

### 🕌 Scholar Review Board (Lajnah) Checklist
*(Only applicable for changes to Arabic Text, Tajweed Rules, translation of sacred texts, or Auditing guidelines)*
- [ ] Correctness of Arabic diacritics (Tashkeel) verified.
- [ ] Canonical categorization of the rule is correct.
- [ ] Authentic source citation matching *Hisnul Muslim* or classical sources verified.
